name: ai-insurance-claims-platform
description: Production-Quality AI-Assisted Insurance Claims Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WORKER,WEB" -c "blue,yellow,green" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:worker && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/shared test && npm --prefix apps/api test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
